summary.name: SimpleLocalize
summary.one_liner: SimpleLocalize is a web-based translation management system for software teams that manages translation files, runs auto-translation, and delivers translations via CLI, GitHub integration, or cloud hosting.
use_cases: Managing app translation files for web and mobile projects
Auto-translating new strings with AI or machine translation
Syncing translation files through CI or GitHub Actions
Letting community contributors translate app content
Hosting translations in the cloud for delivery to apps
Translating a multilingual website with SEO support
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web-based translation editor and CLI for software projects, with commands to upload source strings, auto-translate, publish, and download translated files. Auto-translation uses AI and traditional machine translation, with DeepL, OpenAI and local LLM integrations mentioned. It supports iOS, Android, and Flutter files such as ARB, Strings, and XML, and integrates with React, Next.js, Vue, and Angular. Crowdsourced translation and cloud translation hosting are offered. Developer tools named include a VS Code extension, IntelliJ plugin, and Figma integration.
notable: CLI with upload, auto-translate, publish, and download commands
GitHub App and GitHub Actions integration
Bring-your-own API keys usable on any plan, including free
Per-user pricing not increased by number of users on paid plans
caveats: Paid plans include a monthly allowance of auto-translation characters
Free tier is described as 'Start for free' with no credit card required; full free-tier limits are not stated on the page
